text:
Marta Reyes: Taking primary for the 18:00-02:00 UTC window. Quick status: no active Sev1s, payment-queue latency alert flared earlier but auto-resolved. Leaving notes and runbook snippets below.
Samir Patel: thanks Marta. who is secondary?
Marta Reyes: J. Lee is secondary. Dana is jump-in if we get multi-region impact. @J. Lee can you ack?
J. Lee: ack, I'm secondary. I'll monitor the kv-cache / payment-queue dashboards for the first hour and keep the bridge open if we see >500ms p50.
Ops-Bot: INCIDENTBOT: page created -> #pager-payment-queue (severity: P2) - paging threshold breached at 17:34 UTC, latency spike to 1.8s. auto-mitigation triggered: scaled consumer group by 3.
Samir Patel: noted. Marta, any ongoing mitigations I should be aware of?
Marta Reyes: autoscaler did scale, but we saw a few 503s from the reranker. Action items: 1) check KV cache mempressure, 2) verify consumer group lag, 3) rollback last deploy to reranker if error rate persists.
J. Lee: quick checks I'll run:
```bash
# check pods
kubectl get pods -n inference | egrep "kv-cache|payment-consumer|reranker"
# check consumer lag (kafka)
kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka:9092 --describe --group payment-consumers
```
Marta Reyes: runbook links: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/payment-queue-latency (use section "fast triage") and https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-thrash (prefix/KV rewarm steps).
Dana H: adding a short checklist for handoffs in case ops-bot pages overnight: - If p50 > 800ms for 3 min, escalate to P1 oncall and open bridge. - If error rate > 0.5% for 5m, rollback reranker to last stable. - If consumer lag keeps increasing, temporarily pause non-critical retries.
Samir Patel: can we embed the rollback command here for quick copy-paste?
J. Lee: sure:
```bash
# rollback reranker to v1.3.2 (last known good)
redwoodctl rollout undo service reranker --to-version v1.3.2 --namespace inference
```
Marta Reyes: also small KV warmup snippet if cache was evicted:
```bash
# prefill common prefixes (example):
curl -sS https://tools.redwood.internal/prefill-prefixes | xargs -I {} -n1 -P10 redis-cli -h kv-cache.svc set {}
```
Ops-Bot: REMINDER: runbook link pinned to thread: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/incident-handbook#evening-shift
Samir Patel: Gap note for tonight: I'm offline 00:00-04:00 UTC for a dentist appt; J. Lee will be first responder for pages during that slice. Marta can you add your contact method?
Marta Reyes: DM me on Signal (marta) for urgent P1s; otherwise Slack mention works. Leaving my loud phone number in pager profile.
Dana H: if you need to escalate to Dedicated support (customer-facing SLA risk), follow runbook appendix B and loop in @support-ops. Contact pattern: 30m sustained customer errors OR 5% customer impact.
J. Lee: I'll summarize short handoff message at 22:00 UTC and drop it here so night team knows open tickets and runbook sections.
Marta Reyes: thanks. Final quick tips: - check KV pod memory < 75% to avoid evictions - prefer rollout undo over redeploy for hot fixes - always run smoke test: /healthz and a simple payment flow after mitigation.
Samir Patel: perfect. locking notes into the shift doc now: https://redwood.internal/shifts/2026-03-15-evening
J. Lee: ack, and I'll leave a short seq of commands for the night team in the runbook (small, copyable snippets).
Marta Reyes: closing handoff. If anything pages, start with the runbook Fast Triage then call bridge. :thumbsup:
Ops-Bot: THREAD_SUMMARY: primary=Marta Reyes, secondary=J. Lee, jump-in=Dana H, key runbooks pinned, pager window coverage updated.
